decision.decision_summary: The objective is to read item codes while ignoring shipping labels. I have one development image (media-0e53fc77549b0b5080d45aedd9373425). Before probing, I must discover available capabilities to find one suitable for text/code extraction (OCR or detection). I will list capabilities with a query for 'code' or 'text' to identify the right tool.

Discovered capabilities show 'model.apple-vision' supports 'barcode' tasks and is probe-eligible. The objective is to read an item code (likely a barcode) while ignoring a shipping label. Next, I must inspect the specific descriptor for 'model.apple-vision' to confirm its exact contract and supported request types before running a probe.

Discovered 'model.apple-vision' supports 'barcode' task. Inspected its contract: requires task='barcode', model_id='apple-vision'. Ready to probe. Next: inspect_media to get the development image ID and source_sha256, then run_probe with a barcode request.

Discovered 'model.apple-vision' supports 'barcode' task. Inspected media 'media-0e53fc77549b0b5080d45aedd9373425' (1600x500). Next: run a provisional barcode probe to verify capability and extract item code.

The barcode probe (observation ebcbff419c664b21bf73e9e4346e67eb) returned 0 items, indicating the 'apple-vision' model failed to detect the item code. Since the objective is to read the item code and ignore the shipping label, and the barcode task failed, I will now probe the 'ocr' task on the same image to see if the code can be read as text. This is a necessary alternative experiment based on the failed barcode result.

The OCR probe (obs 6b504f808f3d4b0db73327fa737cf48f) successfully extracted 'QZ-4817' as the item code with 100% confidence, ignoring the shipping label. The barcode probe failed (obs ebcbff419c664b21bf73e9e4346e67eb). Since the goal is to read the item code and OCR succeeded, the next step is to prepare the workflow using the OCR capability.
